title: Tiny, cute glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- left lens frame -->
    <circle cx="36" cy="50" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#7FE7FF" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- right lens frame -->
    <circle cx="64" cy="50" r="15" fill="none" stroke="#7FE7FF" stroke-width="4"/>
    <!-- bridge -->
    <line x1="51" y1="50" x2="49" y2="50" stroke="#7FE7FF" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- left temple arm -->
    <path d="M21 45 Q10 42 8 34" fill="none" stroke="#FFD86B" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- right temple arm -->
    <path d="M79 45 Q90 42 92 34" fill="none" stroke="#FFD86B" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- lens glints -->
    <path d="M28 42 Q31 38 36 38" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <path d="M56 42 Q59 38 64 38" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- cute blush cheeks -->
    <circle cx="20" cy="62" r="4" fill="#FF8FB1" opacity="0.85"/>
    <circle cx="80" cy="62" r="4" fill="#FF8FB1" opacity="0.85"/>
    <!-- little sparkle -->
    <path d="M72 30 L72 24 M72 30 L72 36 M72 30 L66 30 M72 30 L78 30" stroke="#FFE98A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
